notes.title: Play Tukoni: Forest Keepers Demo now!
notes.content:
[p]Hello, Forest Keepers! 🧡[/p][p]The wait is over — the demo of [b]Tukoni: Forest Keepers[/b] is now live on Steam!
[/p][p]Step into the soft paws of Traveller, explore a cozy corner of the forest, meet whimsical critters, and solve gentle puzzles as the Tukoni prepare for winter.[/p][p][/p][p]We can’t wait to hear what you think and hope you enjoy your journey through this hand-drawn world of kindness and tea. [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3723540/Tukoni_Forest_Keepers_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]With warmth, The Tukoni dev team[/p]

notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051864/15da402119793e47e61e220afab86593fc07011c.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Tukoni: Forest Keepers demo[/b] is releasing [b]August 7[/b]! 🧡 [/h3][p]In the demo, you’ll:[/p][list][*][p]Step into the soft paws of [b]Traveller[/b], the Tukoni on a bigger journey than ever before [/p][/*][*][p]Explore [b]Sycamore[/b], a cozy corner where forest keepers Tukoni are getting ready for winter’s arrival [/p][/*][*][p]Solve charming puzzles and meet whimsical characters [/p][/*][*][p]Brew fragrant tea and enjoy a warm, illustrated world filled with kindness[/p][/*][/list][p]We're extremely happy to be going live during the Wholesome Games celebration![/p][p]Don’t forget to [b]wishlist[/b] and [b]follow[/b] to be notified when the demo goes live![/p][p]Kind regards,
[b]Tukoni dev team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Storytelling Through Illustrated Cutscenes in Tukoni: Forest Keepers
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051864/1ca9da91ae02e6df3e00c7b55ba30da644ff408c.png"][/img][/p][p]Dear Forest Keepers,[/p][p]We’re excited to share the new art direction we’ve taken for [b]cutscenes [/b]in Tukoni: Forest Keepers![/p][p]Inspired by [b]picture books and comic books[/b], our cutscenes will now unfold in charming illustrated panels—just like the one you see below. This format feels truest to the world of Tukoni: warm, whimsical, and full of heart. It also lets us stay closer to the visual language of Oksana Bula’s original books, bringing even more storytelling magic to the game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051864/62a000d0e199415487fc1c30f617ce507c93ab8e.png"][/img][/p][p]These cutscenes will gently guide you through the story without breaking the atmosphere of the hand-drawn forest. Think of them as cozy visual storybooks between the puzzles and tea breaks.[/p][p]We hope you’ll enjoy this new approach as much as we’ve enjoyed crafting it![/p][p]Kind regards,
Tukoni dev team[/p]

notes.title: A "Thank You" letter to Epic Games!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051864/d3a9f561a2d6e718a51f732e1742abc3ac137236.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Dear Forest Keepers,[/p][p]We have something personal to share today.[/p][p]Back in 2022, a little over a year after the release of Tukoni: Prologue, we received an [b]Epic MegaGrant[/b] to help bring our dream of a full Tukoni game to life.[/p][p]The grant was a turning point that allowed us to start building [b]Tukoni: Forest Keepers[/b], piece by piece, during one of the most uncertain times in our lives.[/p][p]We’ve waited to talk about this, but now feels like the right time. With the game getting closer to completion, we want to say it out loud:[/p][p][b]Thank you, Epic Games, for believing in our cozy adventure. 🧡[/b][/p][p]Together with the support of our incredible community, [b]Epic MegaGrant[/b] gave us the confidence to keep going, even when things were hard. That support was the seed that helped [b]Tukoni: Forest Keepers[/b] grow into what it is today.[/p][p][/p][p]Kind regards,[/p][p]Tukoni dev team[/p]

notes.title: Discover the Whimsy of Puzzles in Tukoni: Forest Keepers!
notes.content:
Our dear Forest Keepers,

We’re thrilled to share a little peek into the magical puzzles and mini-games waiting for you in Tukoni: Forest Keepers! Whether you’re brewing fragrant teas, organizing cozy spaces, or cracking whimsical padlocks, every challenge is steeped in the charm of our kind hand-drawn world. Here’s a taste of what’s in store:

[h2]The Ritual of Leaves
[/h2]
In the heart of Yavir, the bustling hub where Tukoni gather, you’ll meet Tea Tukoni — the revered master of tea ceremonies. Tea Tukoni will guide you through the ancient art of brewing, teaching you how to combine fragrant herbs found throughout the forest. Each blend brings warmth and comfort to those who sip it. Keep your eyes open for rare herbs and new recipes; every cup is a delightful discovery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051864/53a1a22aa07e83e9206c1a363691d8778ae8f699.png[/img]

[h2]The Art of Tidying
[/h2]
Organizing is an art! Our cozy grid puzzles invite you to fit a variety of items into snug, diegetic spaces. Each object has a unique shape, making it a delightful challenge to get everything to fit just right. In Tukoni: Forest Keepers, organizing spaces becomes part of the adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051864/ecce1bcbeaf59d483028072324954c0ff74e2a05.png[/img]

[h2]The Lore of Locks
[/h2]
The forest spirits and critters may be adorable, but they are also notoriously forgetful! That’s where you come in. Scattered across the world are chests, shelves, and other locked treasures, waiting to be opened. Solve gentle puzzles, follow clever hints, and use your keen observation skills to discover what’s hidden within. Each padlock has a story to tell, so get ready to turn those keys!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051864/2cf657e780eddc2b97b5932194c557c06063f750.jpg[/img]

We can’t wait for you to experience these delightful puzzles and mini-games for yourself. Stay cozy and keep an eye out for more sneak peeks as we get closer to the demo release, and then the launch!

Before we sign off for today, here are two more screenshots from our upcoming game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051864/22bd1e2f1130843f898dba51935ff2427eb01f1f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051864/f287fd0e9374dee4347b48cd567b2fe2a7195d8a.png[/img]
May your teapots stay warm and your puzzles stay delightful! See you soon!

Kind regards, Tukoni dev team.

notes.title: Merry Christmas and thank you for an incredible year!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051864/437fa54352b922e75f3f251d5fa2f35b95d44e6a.jpg[/img]

Greetings, our dear forest keepers!

We wish you a very Merry Christmas! May your days be as warm and delightful as a cup of tea brewed beneath a sky full of sparkling stars. 🌟 May your hearts be filled with love, coziness, and endless wonder! 💙💛

As we prepare to take a short break before embracing all the adventures that 2025 will bring, we thought it would be the perfect time to reflect on some of our biggest milestones from 2024!

[b]Tukoni: Prologue Updates[/b]
We released several updates to the beloved Tukoni: Prologue, fixing critical bugs and adding support for several dozen languages!

[b]Tukoni: Forest Keepers Announced![/b]
The full Tukoni game we've dreamed about for so long (and we know you’ve been dreaming about too!) is finally becoming a reality! We revealed Tukoni: Forest Keepers during the [b]Wholesome Direct 2024[/b] event and were thrilled to see it receive over 3,000 wishlists on the very first day!

[b]Tukoni Team Assembled![/b]
We’ve brought together an amazing team, including many talented folks who worked on Tukoni: Prologue back in 2020, as well as some wonderful new faces. Each one is pouring their heart and soul into the game, and we’re so grateful to be creating Tukoni: Forest Keepers together.

[b]First Screenshots![/b]
This year, we shared the first enchanting glimpses of Yavir, the location we’re currently crafting. We can’t wait to unveil even more magical moments in the coming months!

[b]Incredible Support![/b]
We couldn’t have done it without you—our loyal and supportive forest keepers! Over 27,000 (!) players have wishlisted the game, and we’ve been followed by more than 1,000 fans. Your enthusiasm truly means the world to us.

We’d also like to extend our heartfelt thanks to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/wholesomedirect2024][b]Wholesome Games[/b][/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Women-LedGamesShowcase][b]Women-Led Games[/b][/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/ukrainiangames2024][b]Ukrainian Games Festival[/b][/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/CozyQuest2024][b]Cozy Quest[/b][/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/CozyFamilyFriendlyGamesCelebration][b]Cozy & Family Friendly[/b][/url] games celebration for helping bring Tukoni to players around the world. Your support has been incredible!

[b]Stay Connected![/b]
Be sure to follow our developer page [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/dreamoperator][b]Dream Operator[/b][/url], so you don't miss any updates. You can also find us on [url=https://x.com/dreamoperator][b]Twitter[/b][/url] and [url=https://bsky.app/profile/dream-operator.bsky.social][b]Bluesky[/b][/url]. Let’s stay in touch!

That’s a wrap for now. Thank you for being part of this magical journey with us. See you in 2025!

notes.title: First Tukoni: Forest Keepers screenshots!
notes.content:
Dear Forest Keepers,

It's been some time since our latest update in June! 

We're happy to share that the [b]production for Tukoni: Forest Keepers has been in full swing for a while now[/b]!

Today we'd like to share a glimpse of the game's story, and show you the locations and puzzles we're currently working on!

[i]Before embarking on his important magical journey, our main character Tukoni The Traveller makes a stop in Yavir, the home to all Tukoni of the forest. Here he will meet his old friends, get this year's assignment and learn some important things that will help him along the way. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051864/110ce5b80fcd1a13d16631012e747addc228b8c3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051864/5b4f3914e6ec8b6750baa8c80e4b9d06824509c0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051864/2cf657e780eddc2b97b5932194c557c06063f750.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051864/39079d8d3deb2d57f4d66792faa9893ce3bf3293.jpg[/img]

Before we wrap up, we'd like to thank you all again for your incredible support since our game's announcement! Special thanks to our friends at [url=https://wearesecretmode.com/][b]Secret Mode[/b][/url], who have put up such a heart-warming Cozy Quest lineup this year!

We'd be in touch again before Christmas, and you can await a lot more news from us throughout 2025.

Kind regards, Tukoni dev team.

notes.title: Thank you for 10,000 wishlists!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051864/a7dec14ea79200b1bac3fdfbf2de25a96540cc87.png[/img]

Dear Forest Keepers,

On June 8 we finally shared the news that we had been cooking for some time: the announcement of the full Tukoni game, Tukoni: Forest Keepers.

We wanted to reach out and say a huge [b]'Thank you'[/b] to each and every one of you who wishlisted, created content, shared our full game and played Tukoni: Prologue in the past two weeks. The team is absolutely thrilled to see so many people excited about our game!

We're extremely grateful to [url=https://wholesomegames.com/][b]Wholesome Games[/b][/url] for having us, and to [url=https://www.womenledgames.com/][b]Women-Led Games Showcase[/b][/url] for featuring Tukoni: Prologue and Tukoni: Forest Keepers.

Thanks to the support of so many amazing Forest Keepers around the world, our game has received an incredible[b] 10,000 wishlists in the first two weeks[/b] after the announcement, and we couldn't have been happier!

Have a cozy and peaceful summer, and we'll see you in our next updates about the development of Tukoni: Forest Keepers. 

While we're developing the full game, consider returning to the magical world of Tukoni: Prologue. In the past couple months, we have added many new languages to the UI, fixed several serious bugs and linked a Questionnaire where you can share your thoughts with us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1419860/Tukoni_Prologue/

Kind regards, Tukoni dev team.
